en.title: HUD Updates Accessibility Complaint Deadline for New Housing; Global Standards Advances
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development revised the deadline for filing accessibility complaints on newly built housing, affecting enforcement of fair housing standards. Simultaneously, a new European digital accessibility standard was released, and disability advocates pushed for welfare reform while libraries expanded accessibility book collections. These developments highlight ongoing policy and community efforts to improve disability access.

highlights.title: HUD Has Changed the Deadline for Accessibility Complaints About New Housing - DREDF
Fair housing construction accessibility complaints now have a deadline, HUD says
New European Standard on digital accessibility is out
Advocacy for Welfare Reform for People with Disabilities
List of Libraries with Accessibility Books

zh-TW.title: HUD 調整新住宅無障礙申訴截止日期，歐洲發布新數位無障礙標準
zh-TW.summary: 美國住房與城市發展部修訂新建住宅無障礙申訴的截止日期，影響公平住房法的執行。同時，歐洲發布新版數位無障礙標準 EN 301549，殘障倡議團體推動福利改革，工作隊建議提升無障礙共乘車與移除路徑障礙。這些措施顯示政策與社會共同推進無障礙環境。

highlights.title: HUD 已變更新住宅無障礙申訴的截止日期 - DREDF
公平住房建設無障礙申訴現在有期限，HUD 說明
新版歐洲數位無障礙標準 EN 301549 發布
倡導殘障人士福利改革
殘疾人工作隊建議提供無障礙共乘車、活動、移除路徑障礙等
